prompt.project_info: Create a raw high-fidelity indoor fashion portrait of an approved adult woman seated on a textured sofa in a warm minimalist interior.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with straight dark brunette hair, natural skin texture, calm sideward gaze, and a fine-line rose tattoo on the left shoulder. She wears a black bodycon dress with a square neckline and halter straps, detached black sleeves with lateral cut-outs and thumbholes, seated in a relaxed three-quarter profile with hands resting naturally on the sofa.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 three-quarter portrait, subject seated on a beige sofa and looking toward the left margin, textured stucco wall behind with multiple warm illuminated recessed alcoves and ceramic pottery. Keep tattoo, dress structure, sleeves, hands, and alcove geometry visible.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm 3000K recessed alcove lighting with ray-traced soft shadows, natural skin texture, controlled black fabric detail, and a quiet intimate domestic atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Raw iPhone-style 35mm portrait, f/2.8, authentic digital grain, sharp subject, realistic fabric and skin, accurate hands, natural contrast, no beauty smoothing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a raw high-fidelity 9:16 portrait of an approved adult woman with straight dark brunette hair and natural skin texture, seated on a textured beige sofa in a warm minimalist interior. She looks calmly toward the left margin in a three-quarter profile, with hands resting naturally on the sofa surface. She wears a black dress with a square neckline and halter straps, detached black sleeves with lateral cut-outs and thumbhole details, and has a fine-line rose tattoo on the left shoulder. The background is a stucco-textured wall with several warm illuminated recessed alcoves holding ceramic pottery. Use warm 3000K ambient light, soft ray-traced shadows, realistic black fabric and skin detail, iPhone-style 35mm f/2.8 perspective, authentic digital grain, and no beautify smoothing.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, warped sleeves, text, logo
